commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; adb start-server >/dev/null; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo 'Unexpected Android device model' >&2; exit 20;; esac; if adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep -q '^package:'; then echo 'io.blueeye still installed' >&2; exit 21; fi

set -euo pipefail; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'); test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'

set -euo pipefail; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb install "$APK"; adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep -q '^package:'; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=' | head -n 2; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-monkey.txt 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/tracker-monkey.txt; exit 30; }; sleep 2; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; echo APP_PID=$PID; echo ACCEPTED_APK_INSTALL_PASS; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
